obligations.title: Risk management system
obligations.summary: Establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system across the AI system lifecycle.

obligations.title: Data and data governance
obligations.summary: Training, validation and testing data sets must meet quality criteria including relevance, representativeness, and bias examination.

obligations.title: Transparency and provision of information to deployers
obligations.summary: Provide deployers with instructions for use containing information enabling them to interpret and use the system.

obligations.title: Obligations of deployers of high-risk AI systems
obligations.summary: Use the system in accordance with instructions, ensure human oversight, monitor operation, retain logs.

obligations.title: Transparency obligations for certain AI systems
obligations.summary: Inform users they are interacting with an AI system; mark synthetic content; disclose emotion recognition or biometric categorisation.

obligations.title: Obligations for providers of general-purpose AI models
obligations.summary: Maintain technical documentation, provide information to downstream providers, comply with copyright law, publish a training-data summary.

obligations.title: Obligations for providers of GPAI models with systemic risk
obligations.summary: Model evaluation, systemic-risk assessment and mitigation, serious-incident reporting, cybersecurity protections.
